name: Runes of Power: the Eye of the Beholder in the Abbey hands a Runemaster the quest item (#6588)
contract: Runes of Power (200109, Runemaster, Northshire, from Wanda Belezin 50291 after Runic Inscription 49988) wants one 661330 (RequiredItemId1) from the Eye of the Beholder chest 9301102 (lock 43, loot 9301102 -> 661330 quest-required, Data8 200109, visible only while 200109 is taken). Its one spawn is gameobject guid 7912104 at -8898.6, -181.2 in the Abbey main hall. rev_20260930_98_northshire_baseline_restore deleted that spawn with the rest of the class-chain objects, so the eye did not exist and the quest could not be finished; rev_20261007_20_coa_northshire_class_chain_spawns.sql (#6844) republishes it. Expected: a Runemaster with 200109 in the log finds the world eye lit as a quest object next to its authored spot, and the chest's loot path hands over 661330. The loot actions only open a gameobject the player summoned, so a copy beside the world spawn proves the loot path while the quest-active read proves the world spawn.

steps.label: Join the world phase the Abbey's CoA spawns live in
Let the Abbey's spawns and the login stream settle
Stand in front of Wanda Belezin in the Abbey
Finish the prerequisite Runic Inscription (49988) as a fixture
Hand it in so the chain unlocks
Take Runes of Power (200109) from Wanda the way a player does
Runes of Power is in the log and incomplete
Go to the Eye of the Beholder in the Abbey main hall
DISCRIMINATING: the world eye exists and lights up as a quest object for a Runemaster on 200109
CONTROL: the bags hold no 661330 yet
Stand in a copy of the eye beside the world spawn so the loot actions can open it
the copy is the only eye the loot actions can see
DISCRIMINATING: take 661330 out of the copy - it only rolls for a player on 200109
DISCRIMINATING: the eye pays out the 661330 Runes of Power needs
